question: International Mother Earth Day is celebrated on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**22ⁿd April**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• International Mother Earth Day is celebrated every year on **22nd April**.
 
• The United Nations General Assembly officially designated this day in **2009**.
 
• The day is meant to remind humanity of our collective responsibility to care for the Earth and its ecosystems.
 
• It highlights the importance of sustainable practices to protect the environment for future generations.
 
• Various events and activities are organized globally to promote environmental awareness and actions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of Earth Day:**

 
 
• Earth Day was first celebrated on April 22, 1970.
 
• It was founded by U.S. Senator Gaylord Nelson to raise public awareness about environmental issues.
 
• The first Earth Day saw participation from over 20 million Americans.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Issues Highlighted:**
 
 
• Climate change and global warming.
 
• Deforestation and habitat destruction.
 
• Pollution of air, water, and soil.
 
• Loss of biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Global Earth Day Initiatives:**
 
 
• Planting trees and increasing green cover.
 
• Promoting renewable energy sources.
 
• Reducing plastic usage and enhancing recycling efforts.
 
• Conducting educational programs and workshops on environmental conservation.
 
 
 
• **UN Involvement:**
 
 
• The United Nations plays a significant role in coordinating Earth Day activities globally.
 
• UN supports policies and actions that promote sustainable development.
 
• Several international agreements and conventions are aligned with the objectives of Earth Day.
